Addendum 02 v1.1 §11 specified 'small `MONEY MOMENT · 0X OF 05` eyebrow', but the Owner ruled on 2026-10-06 that the ordinal must NOT be displayed, superseding §11 on this point. ONLY the eyebrow changed: id, placement, milestoneLabel, headline, body, cta and internalPurpose are untouched, so no moment moved and no content changed. sourceDocument: PRD ADDENDUM 02 - ENTRY, IDENTITY, ASSESSMENT PACING & MONEY MOMENTS, v1.1 FINAL BUILD AUTHORITY
_placementNote: §9 headers read 'AFTER DIAGNOSTIC Q5/Q10/Q15/Q20/Q25'. The presentation order is NOT numeric, so two readings were possible. This config uses the Nth-DIAGNOSTIC reading (even intervals: 20/15/10/5/0 diagnostics remaining across the five moments). Three independent checks confirm it, and the third is decisive because it comes from the locked copy itself rather than from inference: (1) the literal-item reading is non-monotonic — Q20 is presented BEFORE Q15, so MM04 would fire before MM03; (2) MM05's own header says 'BEFORE ACTIVATION', true only under this reading; (3) MM05's approved copy says 'Just four more questions before we bring everything together' — under this reading exactly 4 remain (the A1-A4 activation set), under the literal-item reading 10 remain.

moneyMoments.headline: You don't have to solve anything right now.
body: This isn't the part where you fix it, defend it, or explain it.
For now, just keep answering from where you are today.
moneyMoments.internalPurpose: permission and reduced test anxiety without implying that clarity, tracking, or another behavior is the desired answer.

moneyMoments.headline: Your financial life doesn't have to look like anybody else's to be worth understanding.
body: Different life. Different responsibilities. Different starting point.
**Your picture gets to be your picture.**
moneyMoments.internalPurpose: individuality and dignity without teaching a later financial behavior.

moneyMoments.milestoneLabel: MORE THAN HALFWAY THROUGH THE DIAGNOSTIC QUESTIONS
moneyMoments.headline: Two things can be true at the same time.
body: You can be proud of some financial choices and still want others to change.
You can have made progress and still have questions.
You don't have to turn your whole financial life into one verdict.
moneyMoments.internalPurpose: complexity without collapsing the participant into a good/bad financial identity.

moneyMoments.headline: Some questions are easy to answer immediately. Others make you sit with them for a second.
body: You don't need a polished answer. You just need **your answer.**
moneyMoments.internalPurpose: reflection and persistence without teaching fear, trust, professional-agency, or information-to-action responses.

moneyMoments.headline: You've done a lot of honest looking.
body: Just four more questions before we bring everything together and show you what your responses reveal.
Don't change gears now. Answer these the same way you've answered everything else:
moneyMoments.internalPurpose: completion energy without naming or defining Urgency, Readiness, Commitment, or Support Readiness before they are measured.

saveMyProgress._source: Addendum 02 v1.1 §3.1 Optional Save My Progress copy
saveMyProgress._placement: Offered after Money Moment 01 (§3.4). Optional — 'Keep Going Without Saving' continues in the current session without interruption.
saveMyProgress.headline: Want to make sure you don't lose your progress?
body: Save your assessment so you can come back if you need to step away.
saveMyProgress._note: Do not frame identity collection as the price of admission (§3.1). The participant has already been answering; this offers a way to not lose that, and declining costs nothing they have not already been given.

keepNumber._reason: Set for Life Number is internal-system-only (Owner decision, narrative-rewrite scope): the participant-facing read-back screen, the 'Keep this number' language, and the returning-user number input are removed from the journey. Recovery is verified-identity (email), never a memorized identifier. The identifier itself is unchanged in generation, storage, and internal/support lookup; D-1 identity/recovery security is untouched.

sent.label: Check your email
body: If that email can be used with the assessment, a verification link is on its way. Open it to continue.
The link expires in 30 minutes. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder, or return here and try again.
sent._note: Anti-enumeration wording — identical for known and unknown addresses, mirroring components/identity/VerificationState.tsx. The claimed screen confirms the EMAIL flow; no identifier is ever shown (Owner decision, 2026-10-07).
